kinds.description: Disable provider filesystem/network isolation and built-in approval prompts
Translate one Captain policy into the provider's native sandbox
Run the agent inside a container image built from the configured presets
Relocate the run onto an enrolled remote agent over git

disabled.description: Turn off all MCP servers. Honoured on the anthropic cli and the openai agent; accepted and dropped elsewhere.

additionalProperties.description: Whether this resource is loaded for the run.

modes.description: Enable or disable named configured servers.

PermissionMode.description: Base permission posture. Which of these a runtime honours is declared per runtime; see the permissions capability matrix.

Preset.description: Named bundle of safety defaults applied before per-tool rules.

ResourcePolicies.description: Resource IDs mapped to enabled|disabled. A bare string array is accepted and means every listed item is enabled.

additionalProperties.description: Whether this resource is loaded for the run.

SandboxRef.description: Unified sandbox mode and provider-neutral isolation policy

oneOf.description: Isolation boundary: off, provider-native, Docker, or Git Agent

agent.description: Pin one enrolled Git Agent worker

backend.description: Configured Docker or Git Agent backend

paths.description: Gitignore-style path policy for submitted changes

mode.description: Isolation boundary: off, provider-native, Docker, or Git Agent

allowUnsandboxed.description: Allow a provider to request unsandboxed command execution

excludedFromSandbox.description: Commands that run outside native process isolation

deniedEnv.description: Environment variables removed from built-in tools

deniedFiles.description: Credential files hidden from built-in tools

access.description: Native filesystem access granted to built-in provider tools

includeSystemTemp.description: Include system temporary directories in writable roots

access.description: Native network access granted to built-in provider tools

weakerNestedIsolation.description: Permit weaker isolation in nested environments

weakerNetworkIsolation.description: Permit weaker network isolation when proxy enforcement is unavailable

required.description: Fail when the provider-native sandbox is unavailable

ToolPolicy.description: Authority for one tool: auto inherits the posture, ask requires approval, allow auto-approves, deny forbids.

additionalProperties.description: Preference for one tool or group. The legacy on|off spellings are accepted and mean allow|deny.

ToolPreferences.description: Per-turn preference keyed by tool name or group. A tool-name entry overrides its group entry.

additionalProperties.description: Authority for one tool: auto inherits the posture, ask requires approval, allow auto-approves, deny forbids.

Tools.description: Per-tool policy, keyed by tool name. An absent tool inherits the posture.
